verdict.rationale: Clerky's pricing page says founders can complete IRS forms and submit them to the IRS fully online, handled in-house rather than outsourced. That is the mechanism an EIN application would use, but the evidence never names the EIN, Form SS-4, or the resulting federal tax ID. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that EIN/SS-4 filing is included, details of the EIN delivery process and turnaround, and independent or hands-on confirmation of founders obtaining an EIN through Clerky.
